text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear paragraphing and closing letter format","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is structured into coherent paragraphs with an introduction, body, and conclusion, which makes the line of thought easy to follow."},{"evidence":"topic sentences like \"Hiring someone who doesn't have experience... can be a good thing\"","quality":"development of ideas","description":"It develops its position with distinct reasons and explanations rather than repeating the same point in many forms."},{"evidence":"\"can help grow that person professionally\"; \"expand company diversity and skills\"","quality":"specific support","description":"The essay uses more concrete, relevant supporting ideas to illustrate its claims."},{"evidence":"\"learning and adapt\"; \"benefit employers\"; \"make the employee much better and more reliable\"","quality":"academic vocabulary","description":"It shows a wider range of precise word choice appropriate to an argumentative essay."},{"evidence":"mostly controlled sentences with only occasional errors","quality":"sentence control","description":"The writing has better grammatical control and fewer disruptions to meaning than the other essay."},{"evidence":"\"At some point even the employer was given a chance\"","quality":"coherence","description":"Ideas are linked logically from one sentence to the next so the argument progresses more smoothly."}]}
